main_text.p: gesta fuerunt Principum Ducumque sermones; eosdem habet Historia compositos à disertissimis hominibus, elaboratos cunctante stylo, & exoticam istam imaginationem, qua quondam Heroës effinximus, exæquantes: Insuper quæ vulgaribus circumstantiis immixta, latebant partim, & partim communione viluerant, juxta regulam Historiæ præcisa, jam omnino sunt alia, jam ad oculati quoque testis suspensionem insolescunt, rara penitus & augusta sunt: Speculum Veritatis est Historia; sed auget formam: textrix est; & telam, cui Natura cum auro fortè & bysso, vilem lanam & canabim interneverat, rudi glomo rejecto, retexit in Attalicum Paludamentum. page.notes: The left margin carries cropped fragments of the facing page (partly legible words such as "gesta" at the bottom); these were not transcribed. Line-end hyphens are printed and kept. Some words are set with irregular spacing in the original (e.g. "Speculum Veritatis", "bysso" with a possibly Latin o rather than Greek letter in the last syllable; read as printed).
